## Summary
- Unfiltered `npx turbo run build` currently dies at `@filefn/docs#build`, which blocks the repo-wide `JavaScript` CI check for every PR.
- `@docsfn/svelte@0.0.3` is a published registry package (there is no `docsfn/` workspace on `dev`) that ships raw `<script lang="ts">` `.svelte` files. Docs sites alias those files from `node_modules`.
- `ssr.noExternal` listed only `@docsfn/core`, so Vite treated `@docsfn/svelte` as an external Node package. Even after compiling the aliased components, Svelte 5's native TypeScript stripper leaves optional-parameter syntax behind (`activePath?: string` becomes `activePath?`), and Rollup then fails with `Expected ',', got '?'`.
- Affected SvelteKit docs sites on `dev` are `@filefn/docs` and `@authfn/docs`. Other docs sites (`@datafn/docs`, `@searchfn/docs`, `@hostfn/docs`, `@billfn/docs`) are Next/fumadocs and do not consume `@docsfn/svelte`. There is no shared Vite config to patch once.

## Fix
- Add `@docsfn/svelte` to `ssr.noExternal` in both docs Vite configs so the package stays in Vite's transform pipeline.
- Enable `vitePreprocess({ script: true })` in both `svelte.config.js` files so esbuild actually strips TypeScript (including `?:`) before Rollup parses the compiled JS. Default `vitePreprocess()` only handles styles; Svelte 5 claims to strip TS natively, but it does not handle this optional-parameter case.
- Add `@uifn/core@0.0.1` as a devDependency of `@authfn/docs`, matching `@filefn/docs`. Once `@docsfn/svelte` is bundled, `DocsSearch` pulls in `@uifn/svelte`, which imports `@uifn/core/primitives/accordion`. Vite resolves that from the docs package root during SSR build, so authfn needs the same direct dependency filefn already had.

EOF

## Reproduction matched, with a sharper root cause

The original `@filefn/docs` failure was exactly as reported:

```
node_modules/@docsfn/svelte/src/SidebarGroup.svelte (8:63): Expected ',', got '?'
function hasActiveLink(item: SidebarItem, activePath?: string): boolean {
```

Adding `@docsfn/svelte` to `ssr.noExternal` alone was **not** enough. Vite/Svelte **did** compile that file; Svelte 5’s native TS stripper turned `activePath?: string` into invalid JS `activePath?`, and Rollup then died. Default `vitePreprocess()` only handles styles (`script` defaults to `false`).

## Affected sites and changes

Only two SvelteKit docs sites consume `@docsfn/svelte` on `dev`. `@datafn/docs`, `@searchfn/docs`, `@hostfn/docs`, and `@billfn/docs` are Next/fumadocs. There is no shared Vite config.

| Site | Changes |
|---|---|
| `@filefn/docs` | `ssr.noExternal` += `@docsfn/svelte`; `vitePreprocess({ script: true })` |
| `@authfn/docs` | same, plus `@uifn/core@0.0.1` as a devDependency (filefn already had this) |

`@uifn/core` was needed on authfn because once `@docsfn/svelte` is bundled, `DocsSearch` pulls in `@uifn/svelte`, which imports `@uifn/core/primitives/accordion`. Vite resolves that from the docs package root during SSR build.

## Verification

- `npx turbo run build --filter=@filefn/docs` — success  
- `npx turbo run build --filter=@authfn/docs` — success  
- `npx turbo run test --filter=@filefn/docs --filter=@authfn/docs` — success (`--passWithNoTests`; no test files)

Repo-wide `npx turbo run build` now gets past the docs sites and fails next at pre-existing **`@uifn/examples#build`**: `@uifn/examples-shared` cannot find `@uifn/components` / `@uifn/theme` / `@uifn/patterns` (turbo ordering). That is PR #142’s area and was left untouched.
